name: Fortinet FortiGate
description: Reads a FortiGate firewall (FortiOS 6.4 or newer) with a read-only REST token: the firewall as the gateway with its interfaces, the devices behind it (DHCP leases, device identification, ARP), and its health: high availability, VPN tunnels, firmware and licence expiry. Netlens shows them on a Firewall card and logs events for failover, tunnels going down and licences about to expire. Read-only: only GET requests. Not yet tested on a real firewall.
author: Netlens
supports: FortiOS 6.4 or newer (tested against a simulator only)

releases.changelog: First release. Written from the vendor's public API documentation and tested against a simulator only: please try it on a real firewall and send the Run diagnostic report if something is missing (needs Netlens 0.4.152 or newer for the Firewall card).
